sentences.text: Aggrieved by the quantum of compensation fixed by the 2nd respondent, the petitioner sought for enhancement of compensation and the matter was referred to arbitration by 1st respondent.
Though the claim petitions of the petitioner seeking enhancement of compensation dated 14.05.2023 and 05.07.2023 are pending on the file of the 1st respondent, till date, no order has been passed.
Therefore, the petitioner is before this Court.

4. Mr.A Selvendran, learned Special Government Pleader takes notice for the respondents 1 & 2 and Mrs.S.R.Sumathy, learned Standing Counsel takes notice for the 3rd respondent.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 5.
The learned Additional Government Pleader appearing for the respondents 1 & 2 would submit that the arbitral proceedings will be completed within the time fixed by this Court.

6. It is the duty of the 1st respondent to complete arbitral proceedings within the time limit prescribed under the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 and he cannot keep the arbitral proceedings pending for ever without passing final award.

Therefore, without going into the merits of the claim made by the petitioner, this Court is inclined to direct the 1st respondent to complete the arbitral proceedings pending on his file in respect of claim made by the petitioner and pass final award on its own merit, within a period of six months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 7.
With the above direction, the Writ Petition stands disposed of.
No costs.
